title: eval-harness: CI prompt-set regression gating + eval metrics integration
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds CI gating that fails PRs when prompt-set eval metrics regress beyond configured thresholds; integrates eval metrics export to our CI dashboard for historical tracking and alerts.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see subtle prompt-set regressions after model swaps or prompt formatting changes. This PR introduces a CI gating step that runs eval-harness prompt-set checks against baseline metrics and fails the pipeline when regressions exceed configurable thresholds. It also pushes per-run metrics to the CI metrics exporter so we have longitudinal visibility and can alert on quality drift.

What changed: - Added a new eval-harness CI hook (scripts/ci/eval_gate.py) which runs selected prompt-sets, computes aggregated metrics (accuracy, exact_match, normalized_score), and compares to baseline JSONs stored under eval-harness/baselines/. - Introduced a config-driven thresholds file (eval-harness/ci_thresholds.yaml) with per-prompt-set and per-metric tolerances and an overall failure_policy (strict/warn/skip). - Integrated metrics exporter (tools/ci_metrics_exporter) to post results to our CI metrics dashboard (prometheus/grafana pipeline). - Added fixtures and deterministic prompts for unit/integration testing. - Updated CI workflows (.github/workflows/eval-gate.yml) to run on push/PR and gate merges. - Documentation and runbook in eval-harness/README_CI.md.

Testing: - Unit tests for eval comparator and metric aggregators. - Small integration job runs in CI using a lightweight model sandbox to validate end-to-end behavior. - Local manual runs documented in README_CI.md.

Rollout plan: Start as opt-in by label ("eval-gate:opt-in") for two weeks, then enable for model/serving changes only. If flakiness observed, teams can set per-prompt-set failure_policy: warn to avoid merge failures while they investigate.

Checklist: - [x] Implement eval gate CLI and CI hook - [x] Add baseline artifacts and threshold config - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] CI workflow and exporter integration - [x] Docs and runbook
